from virtua import Prescription, Chemist, Lab, Admin, Patient

        patient.prescriptions.append(prescription)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(patient.prescriptions), 1)
        self.assertEqual(patient.prescriptions[0], prescription)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(chemist.prescriptions), 1)
        self.assertEqual(chemist.prescriptions[0], prescription)

        # Arrange
        lab = Lab()
        prescription = Prescription("medication", "dosage", "frequency")
        lab.prescriptions.append(prescription)

        # Act
        lab.receive_prescription(prescription)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(lab.prescriptions), 1)
        self.assertEqual(lab.prescriptions[0], prescription)

        # Act
        lab.update_lab_reports_on_system(prescription)

        self.assertEqual(len(lab.prescriptions), 1)
        self.assertEqual(lab.prescriptions[0], prescription)
